title: Round at a Terminator
statement: Let $x,p,r$ be bit strings, let $j$ be a natural number, and let $q$ be one of the five streaming phases with $q \ne 4$. If $x$ is the concatenation of $p$, the bit $0$, and $r$, then one round from the state with fresh cursor $j$, consumed length $|p|$, and phase $q$ consumes the terminator and emits $[0]$. Its new cursor is $j$, its consumed length is $|p|+1$, and its phase is $4$ if $q=0$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is a phase in the five-element phase set
replaced:
Let the input be $p \mathbin{+\!\!+} 0 :: r$ and the seam state have consumed
$|p|$ bits in a non-finished phase $q$. The round emits $[0]$, consumes one bit,
and moves to the finished phase when $q$ was the formula phase and back to the
formula phase otherwise.
